G_replay_and_provenance.G4_negative_basis_preserved: PASS - every negative decision retains its exact basis_refs; a negative finding without basis is refused at construction ('silence is never a verdict')
G_replay_and_provenance.G5_no_negative_carries_admission_provena: PASS - a non-positive result carrying admission provenance is refused at construction

G_replay_and_provenance.G7_permutation_determinism: PASS - see 03; 1 distinct replay identity under all permutations of both candidate order and authority-record order
G_replay_and_provenance.G8_refusal_basis_preserved: PASS - refusals are typed exceptions carrying a distinct code (e.g. CANDIDATE_CLASS_BROADENING_OR_NARROWING_REFUSED, SOURCE_ACCESS-style typed codes) rather than a generic error, so a refusal is auditable from its code

immutability_note: the receipt and its decisions are frozen dataclasses; the resolver uses object.__setattr__ only to set the derived canonical_replay_only_order on the freshly-built receipt. Callers cannot mutate a resolved receipt in place.
